item.title: 6 Open-World RPGs With Perfect Skill Tree Systems
item.description:
Many aspects contribute to whether you’ll be hooked on a new open-world role-playing game for hundreds of hours or bounce off after the first few. Besides the obvious graphics, story, characters, world, and quests, progression systems shouldn’t be underestimated. For some players, intricate weapon systems can add another meaningful layer to chase and keep them additionally invested. Character progression can be another factor that separates the urge to keep leveling in an open world from a meaningless level number that barely changes how the core gameplay feels.

For the games below, it’s not just about deep character progression. That can be achieved in various ways, from good class or equipment systems to the popular learn-by-doing approach. Instead, each game below offers an actual skill tree or branching perk-grid structure that’s satisfying to explore and invest in over long-term play. Moreover, we’ll prioritize skill trees that give you noticeably different abilities and can result in creative, diverse builds—not merely those increasing your stats through boring numbers.

Assassin’s Creed Shadows

Two Characters With Distinct Skill Trees Tied To Each Weapon Type

While its reputation remains divisive, for its genre, Assassin’s Creed Shadows actually did many things extremely well. The risky concept of separating the samurai warrior and agile shinobi archetypes between Yasuke and Naoe worked better than sticking with a single middling protagonist, and the game’s progression and gear systems offer enough depth, variety, and impact to experiment with for hours on end. Moreover, the game separates regular experience-based leveling from Knowledge progression, resulting in more layered advancement and the need to chase specific side activities to grow.

8 Most Overpowered RPG Abilities Ever

Unleash these game-breaking RPG abilities. From summoning demons to one-shotting bosses, these abilities will make your gaming experience a breeze.

1
By Evan Regan

Both Naoe and Yasuke in AC Shadows can wield different weapon types, and their multiple skill trees are built to reflect that. Simple, clean, and effective, you can prioritize general aspects like Naoe’s stealth and Yasuke’s samurai training, as well as focus on your primary weapon choice, unlocking and improving useful perks or choosing between several active skills with unique animations and effects. Everything can then be enhanced and further altered for the best synergies with your weapon perks and engravings. Better yet, Mastery nodes can be reset at any time, making experimentation with different approaches painless.

The final layer is the game’s Knowledge tree, which lets you invest further in passive abilities later on. While this is easily the least impactful progression system of the bunch, it tightens up your earlier chosen path for an even stronger build identity.

Diablo 4

A Weak Start Evolves Into Something Much More Impressive

Unlike AC Shadows , where you get just two “classes” with different build branches, Diablo 4 expands that number to eight as of this writing, and each class comes with a dedicated and original skill tree to gradually master. Following the main path, you decide which nodes and abilities to pick, as well as evolve or alter them in major ways through modifiers—an idea familiar from Diablo 3 .

While it’s fair to say Diablo 4 took quite some time and plenty of fan feedback to substantially rework its initially half-baked progression and skill trees, the game finally approaches that satisfying balance between complex depth and accessible fun. The latest version moved further away from boring number-driven enhancements like +15% skill damage, with far more abilities and modifiers now capable of meaningfully changing how your build actually works.

The latest updates pushed each class’ progression to entirely new heights, allowing individual skills to be modified in more ways and resulting in far more possible combinations than before. Some can even change a skill’s entire category, like turning Fire into Frost or Bone into Blood, opening up completely new synergies with gear. Credit where it’s due: Diablo 4 might not reach the bar set by Path of Exile for sheer flexibility, but fans can finally build their favorite classes in ways that reflect their personal combat priorities. Even better, skill trees are still just one layer of the game’s much deeper stat engagement.

Kingdoms Of Amalur: Re-Reckoning

Still Remembered For Doing Leveling Extremely Well

Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning is the type of open-world RPG that only seems to become more fondly remembered over time, especially in light of the upcoming Fable , as Amalur might be the closest thing out there to make waiting until February a bit more manageable. When it comes to character progression, the game lets you build your class freely rather than adopt an existing one, and its skill trees are a perfect example of that.

10 RPGs With Skill Trees So Massive They Might Be A Puzzle Themselves

Your head is bound to start spinning trying to comprehend the gigantic skill trees in these RPG titles.

By Ollie Tuscarny

Three distinct combat trees (Might, Finesse, and Sorcery) provide plenty of free-form ways to mix different abilities however you see fit. This feeds directly into the game’s signature Destiny system, representing Reckoning’s continuously evolving class progression and rewarding both pure specialization and hybrid builds between all three major branches.

Like in many of the best open-world RPGs with rich character-building options, Kingdoms of Amalur’s most exciting nodes unlock distinct active abilities, new attacks, or meaningful combat perks rather than boring percentage additions to damage or character health. At the same time, investing points in any branch doesn’t just unlock new moves and tricks; it gradually shapes your character into a dedicated warrior, mage, or something entirely different once you start feeding another branch. The biggest issue in Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning , though, is its less-than-perfect balance, with some abilities being vastly more useful than others.

Borderlands 4

Shape Each Vault Hunter Into Several Substantially Different Characters

Quite possibly the biggest entry in the series in almost every regard, Borderlands 4 features four Vault Hunters (and now an additional wild-card DLC one), but that’s just for starters. While previous entries already offered plenty of freedom within each class, Borderlands 4 pushes that concept further, with every Vault Hunter essentially capable of becoming three substantially different versions of the same character.

You could almost say there are 12 core playable archetypes among the four original Vault Hunters, determined by robust and varied skill trees built around three distinct Action Skills for each. These can be switched freely even without investing in their corresponding tree, while deeper investment unlocks more powerful ways to alter and specialize them. This makes the opening choice flexible while rewarding commitment later. Not to mention how Borderlands 4’s incredible gear and weapon systems further multiply all the possible combinations within a specific build.

For long-term progression in Borderlands 4 , Specializations take the spotlight as an account-wide incremental tree for additional passive bonuses and further refinement—almost akin to the Mastery layer in AC Shadows . And DLC hunter C4SH also deserves a mention for deliberately breaking the familiar design with unpredictable, RNG-driven Action Skills and a different approach to customization.

The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim

Remains One Of The Most Natural Forms Of Classless Buildcrafting

After almost 15 years, The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim’s classless system and progression hardly surprise anymore, as its individual skill trees are far from the deepest among this open-world RPG selection. Nevertheless, the game remains one of the best examples of growing skills through your actions rather than simply investing abstract points, featuring a simple and elegant loop of using skills, improving them, specializing further, and gradually creating an emergent build identity based on your playstyle.

Skyrim’s skill-tree architecture, which features 18 independent skills, visually represented as separate constellations, is as iconic and simple as it gets, but there’s still plenty of layering and variety. Using a skill to level it is one thing; spending perk points to specialize further is another, but both are tightly connected. The cross-tree synergies from non-combat skills like Smithing, Alchemy, or Enchanting are arguably even more important than the complexity of any single branch.

6 Open-World RPGs With The Most Unique Leveling Systems

The games below might not have the best leveling systems in the genre, but they certainly try to do things in their own way.

5
By Vlad Mazanko

This creates one of the most natural forms of classless buildcrafting in the genre, as you might not even know what your character will be most proficient in later on when you’re just starting the game, unless you already want to pursue a specific skill combination. Of course, Skyrim’s skills can be wildly uneven, with iconic OP builds like the notorious Stealth Archer or Illusion Assassin notably outperforming almost any other combination.

Tainted Grail: The Fall Of Avalon

Traditional Skill Trees At A Glance, Extremely Flexible For Creative Hybrids Later On

Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon is often compared to Skyrim , and while the game also features classless and flexible progression, its skill trees are far more nuanced. The game gives you vast freedom to create unusual hybrids, where skill investments, attributes, gear, and crafting all play a part in shaping a single build.

The Fall of Avalon offers six separate main skill trees, driven by core attributes like Strength, Spirituality, or Practicality. The most fun you’ll have in the game isn’t merely advancing one branch to its fullest, but figuring out what can be combined together. Tainted Grail is all about coming up with an extremely odd idea and then finding the tools to execute it. A bare-fisted alchemist-berserker can be perfectly viable, and so can a blacksmith-mage summoning undead. Lots of layers and systems can easily coexist within one character, even if the game doesn’t offer the largest number of nodes to learn.

Knowing the intricacies of Tainted Grail’s skill investments and their payoffs can become especially valuable in its unique Challenge Mode, where persistent debuffs force you to think harder about how your build works and how to suppress their nastiest effects. And the game’s Sanctuary of Sarras expansion shakes up progression once more, adding three new skill trees that can be switched around when needed, bringing yet another customization layer to an already deep progression system.

item.title: How to Get the Safe Code in Destructive Power of Mind in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC
item.description:
While exploring Lab X16 during the Destructive Power of Mind mission in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC, players will come across an operating theater with a safe that requires a six-digit code. There's also the letter "N" marked to the left of the keypad, as well as a projector in the room that may help players get the Lab X16 safe code and loot the rewards inside.

Should You Side With Zulu or Mavka in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope? (All Endings)

Players will be presented with an ending-related choice to either side with Mavka or Zulu in Destructive Power of Mind in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope.

By Ayyoun Ali

How to Get Lab X16 Safe Code in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope (The Destructive Power of Mind)

Find All Projector Slides & View Them

To get the Lab X16 safe code during the Destructive Power of Mind quest in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope , you'll need to find the projector slides and decipher the code from them. The first slide can be found right after you exit the ventilation ducts and open up a gate for Duty soldiers. Turn right and go into the room right beside the large 3 marked on the wall (to the left).

You'll find the first projector slide sitting on a table in the room. Once you grab it, head towards the main operation theater area with the projector.

Head up the stairs opposite the safe's location, and you'll come across a small control terminal overseeing a large cage downstairs. Push the red button on the terminal to open the door to the cage below.

Head downstairs and enter the cage to find the second projector slide on the electroshock therapy chair .

Now, all you need to do is head back to the operation theater and interact with the projector to start viewing the slides.

  • The first slide to watch is the one that displays N17 in the bottom-right corner of the image.
  • The second slide to analyze is the one that displays N 10.08 in the top-left corner, with the ".08" section being almost diminished and hard to see unless you get close to the screen.

Lab X16 Safe Code

So, players will identify the Lab X16 safe code to be 171008 in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope , after viewing the slides on the projector during the Destructive Power of Mind quest.

Enter the six-digit code into the keypad to open up the safe and get the Brummbar Exoskeleton as a reward. It's one of the best pieces of armor in the game, and players must first upgrade to unlock sprinting as well as multiple lead containers to use artifacts without experiencing radiation.

item.title: PSA: GTA 6 Malware Is Officially Here, Looking More Believable Than It Should
item.description:
Malware posing as playable copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 has been spotted online in non-trivial numbers for the first time ever. While the game is still months away from release, the timing is not accidental but rather a direct result of the still-ongoing barrage of GTA 6 leaks that has been spreading online in late August 2026.

The person or group responsible for the latest drama, CyberLeek, has consistently framed its activities as "fighting for gamers" by protesting some of Rockstar's business practices. Its since-pulled "Edict" railed against digital preorders, paid unlocks for single-player content already present in day-one game files, and publishers rendering single-player games inaccessible after shutting down their servers. However, that consumer-rights framing has been accompanied by some conspicuously commercial ventures, as CyberLeek leveraged it to promote the launch of its cryptocurrency and more recently even offered to sell ad space on future GTA 6 leaks.

Anonymous Comments on GTA 6 Leaks

The Anonymous social media account issues a statement on the ongoing Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks that have made the rounds.

By James Ratcliff

GTA 6 Malware Is Capitalizing on the CyberLeek Chaos

A number of piracy sites have seen an influx of downloads claiming to contain playable GTA 6 builds in late August 2026. While virtually every high-profile game has its name used in such scams, what makes this latest trend notable is that CyberLeek's brazen sharing of GTA 6 footage stirred up enough chaos to lend the claims more credibility than they would ordinarily have. According to NordVPN CTO Marijus Briedis, every single instance of GTA 6 making headlines is followed by leaked footage being (re)shared online via Discord, mirror sites, and re-uploads on mainstream sites. He identified that as "exactly the environment where fake 'leak' downloads and credential-harvesting pages thrive," having said as much in a recent statement to IGN.

Fake GTA 6 Downloads Look More Believable Than They Normally Would

Under normal circumstances, claims that an unreleased AAA game is available to download from a random piracy site would be safe to dismiss without checking. GTA 6 , however, has an unusually extensive history of genuine leaks, dating back to a September 2022 internal network breach that led to roughly 90 videos from an early development build spreading online. The August 2026 incident has produced another steady stream of leaked GTA 6 footage that Take-Two officially confirmed as legitimate.

Between that and the fact that CyberLeek has openly threatened to release their playable build in recent updates to its heavily mirrored website, the idea of unauthorized GTA 6 copies existing outside Rockstar's control is already established in the public consciousness. That can help malicious actors sell relatively simple scams, such as naming a 113.9GB malware file "grand.theft.auto.vi.gta.6.cyberleek.build.v1.287.0.lucia.repack.iso," seeding it on torrent sites, and wait for victims to find it.

The first official look at GTA 6 gameplay is scheduled for August 27, 2026, at 3 p.m. ET / 9 p.m. CET. It will arrive as part of a broader preview event that will remain a Netflix exclusive for six hours before Rockstar re-shares it across its social media channels. The showcase is expected to run for roughly 30 minutes, which makes it likely to go down in history as the longest single pre-release look at GTA 6 to date—at least assuming CyberLeek does not take that as a challenge and tries to one-up it, which would be on brand for the kind of chaos they have been stirring up so far.

Malware posing as playable copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 has been spotted online in non-trivial numbers for the first time ever. While the game is still months away from release, the timing is not accidental but rather a direct result of the still-ongoing barrage of GTA 6 leaks that has been spreading online in late August 2026.

The person or group responsible for the latest drama, CyberLeek, has consistently framed its activities as "fighting for gamers" by protesting some of Rockstar's business practices. Its since-pulled "Edict" railed against digital preorders, paid unlocks for single-player content already present in day-one game files, and publishers rendering single-player games inaccessible after shutting down their servers. However, that consumer-rights framing has been accompanied by some conspicuously commercial ventures, as CyberLeek leveraged it to promote the launch of its cryptocurrency and more recently even offered to sell ad space on future GTA 6 leaks.

Anonymous Comments on GTA 6 Leaks

The Anonymous social media account issues a statement on the ongoing Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks that have made the rounds.

By James Ratcliff

GTA 6 Malware Is Capitalizing on the CyberLeek Chaos

A number of piracy sites have seen an influx of downloads claiming to contain playable GTA 6 builds in late August 2026. While virtually every high-profile game has its name used in such scams, what makes this latest trend notable is that CyberLeek's brazen sharing of GTA 6 footage stirred up enough chaos to lend the claims more credibility than they would ordinarily have. According to NordVPN CTO Marijus Briedis, every single instance of GTA 6 making headlines is followed by leaked footage being (re)shared online via Discord, mirror sites, and re-uploads on mainstream sites. He identified that as "exactly the environment where fake 'leak' downloads and credential-harvesting pages thrive," having said as much in a recent statement to IGN.

Fake GTA 6 Downloads Look More Believable Than They Normally Would

Under normal circumstances, claims that an unreleased AAA game is available to download from a random piracy site would be safe to dismiss without checking. GTA 6 , however, has an unusually extensive history of genuine leaks, dating back to a September 2022 internal network breach that led to roughly 90 videos from an early development build spreading online. The August 2026 incident has produced another steady stream of leaked GTA 6 footage that Take-Two officially confirmed as legitimate.

That can help malicious actors sell relatively simple scams, such as naming a 113.9GB malware file "grand.theft.auto.vi.gta.6.cyberleek.build.v1.287.0.lucia.repack.iso," seeding it on torrent sites, and wait for victims to find it.

It will arrive as part of a broader preview event that will remain a Netflix exclusive for six hours before Rockstar re-shares it across its social media channels. The showcase is expected to run for roughly 30 minutes, which makes it likely to go down in history as the longest single pre-release look at GTA 6 to date—at least assuming CyberLeek does not take that as a challenge and tries to one-up it, which would be on brand for the kind of chaos they have been stirring up so far.

item.title: STALKER 2: All Binoculars & How to Get Them
item.description:
Binoculars are handy tools for scouting in STALKER 2 , but more advanced variants do more than just help you see farther. The fancier binoculars you can find in the zone can help with target identification, making them perfect for figuring out which bad guys you should be shooting. All binoculars in STALKER 2 can be obtained for free, though some can also be bought from traders in the many safe havens all over the Zone.

Should You Side With Zulu or Mavka in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope? (All Endings)

Players will be presented with an ending-related choice to either side with Mavka or Zulu in Destructive Power of Mind in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope.

By Ayyoun Ali

FOB-45 Binoculars Overview & Location

You can buy a pair of simple binoculars for 2000 Coupons from Hamster , the trader in the starting town of Zelissya . You can buy it as soon as you scrounge up the money for it, though you may need to progress through the first few beginner quests before Hamster starts selling them to you.

As the first-ever pair of binoculars you can find, these are the most basic of binoculars you can find in the zone . They don't really do anything except give you a clearer view of things that are far away without being forced to equip something like a sniper rifle or a weapon with a high-magnification scope. They're nothing fancy, but they get the job done.

To use binoculars in STALKER 2 , equip them from your inventory, then open your item wheel. Look for your equipped binoculars on the screen, then press the related button that appears.

Yastrub Binoculars Overview & Location

This is the second type of binoculars in the game, and you can get one for free by going to the comms room at the very top of the Cement Factory northeast of Garbage . The location in question is inside the factory itself, which is occupied by Duty members. Head to the tallest point of the Cement Factory via the winding stairwell, then grab the Yastrub from the equipment table in front of the door.

As a direct upgrade to the regular binoculars, the Yastrub comes with a built-in entity detector and rangefinder . Viewing any NPC with the Yastrub will show a bracket around them , and you'll see the NPC's name too. This makes target identification much easier, and you can use the rangefinder to dial-in your long-range shots too.

Fighter Binoculars Overview & Location

The third type of binoculars is the Fighter, and while it functions mostly the same as the Yastrub, this one has a friend-or-foe detector that automatically recognizes if a targeted NPC is hostile or not. You can pick up a free Fighter binoculars by going to the Scorcher Technical Tunnel in Malachite (open the door using the code 1287975.

You can get another one from the tower near Yaniv station after you make enough progress through the main STALKER 2 story.

The Fighter binoculars have the same NPC identification brackets as the Yastrub, except the brackets will be red if you're viewing hostile NPCs . This way, you won't have to worry about manually identifying uniforms, which is useful for spotting hostile Mercenaries in groups of otherwise-neutral army soldiers.

S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl

item.title: Palworld Card Game Update is Good News for Fans
item.description:
A new update from the Palworld Official Card Game brings news that fans have been waiting to hear, confirming new print runs for the Dawn of Palpagos expansion. The first set of the Palworld trading card game has already been a hot commodity among fans and collectors.

The launch of Palworld 's TCG adaptation has already been a huge success for Pocketpair and Bushiroad. The game's initial launch came with the release of its first full set, Dawn of Palpagos, alongside two trial decks for the game, featuring both fan-favorite Pals, such as Chillet and Lyleen, and some important human characters, including Zoe and Lily. However, the card game's success has made it the target of scalpers early into its life, with boxes of Palworld 's first set being resold for significant markups and some cards even selling for hundreds, if not thousands, of dollars. Now, the Palworld Official Card Game is taking steps to alleviate its supply issues.

'Players Do Not Realize The Sheer Number of Collabs We've Rejected' Palworld Dev Comments on Terraria Crossover

One of Palworld's most notable developers is sharing details about the company's practice for adding new collaborations to the game.

By Michael Brandon Ingram

Palworld Official Card Game's First Set is Getting Reprints

The Palworld Official Card Game recently made an announcement about shortages on the game's social media. The creators of the TCG apologized for early supply issues with the Dawn of Palpagos set, which made it difficult for many fans to buy the cards. Bushiroad confirmed that the company is in the process of providing more stock of the Palworld Official Card Game 's first set to stores, also revealing that Dawn of Palpagos will receive a "2nd Edition" print run in order to ensure demand is met for the set. The company did not confirm when the second print run of Dawn of Palpagos will roll out, with more details said to be provided "in the near future."

New print runs for Dawn of Palpagos will likely be a relief for many fans waiting to pick up the trading card game. The game's first set features 100 unique cards across four different rarities, alongside 61 alternate parallel-rarity versions of some of its biggest cards. Many of the full-art OSR and SP rarity cards have already begun to sell for significant prices on the secondary market, with several Palworld cards selling for more than $100. The biggest chase card in the set has easily been the gold SSS version of popular early-game Pal Cattiva, with some early copies selling for as much as $4,000.

The upcoming reprints for Dawn of Palpagos come as the Palworld TCG has already given fans a look ahead at the game's future. Bushiroad has officially revealed the first post-launch expansion coming to the card game, with Legends Awaken launching as the second full set in October 2026. Legends Awaken will introduce several popular Pals to the card game for the first time, including Chillet Ignis and Jetragon, and will be accompanied by two new Trial Decks releasing in December 2026.

'Players Do Not Realize The Sheer Number of Collabs We've Rejected' Palworld Dev Comments on Terraria Crossover

The early popularity of the Palworld Official Card Game comes just after a major moment for the franchise. Palworld officially launched the Version 1.0 update for the main game in early July, marking the full launch of the game more than two years after its early access debut. Pocketpair has also confirmed multiple spin-offs in the works for Palworld , revealing both a farming sim in Palworld: Palfarm and a mobile-focused MMORPG in Palworld Online . Fans of Palworld have every reason to be excited about the game's future, with plenty in store as the brand expands even further.
